TWA's NEW

and the most comfortable
The L-1011 has been called "the next
generation of the jet age."
It brings together every significant ad-
vance in aircraft design and comfort you've
ever enjoyed on any other plane.
On TWA's L-1011, you'll find the spa-
ciousness of our 747's. The Coach and First
Class lounges and special new seats of
our 747's and 707's. Dining service that
eliminates, for the first time on any airplane,
the need for aisle carts. Even the carry-on
luggage compartments of our 727's. Plus
many new comfort features that make TWA's
L-1011 the premier new member of the most
comfortable fleet of planes in the world.
When you fly TWA's L-1011, you get our
popular Ambassador Service:
Ambassador Service is a total travel ex-
perience. It means curbside check-in and
containerized handling for your baggage.
Gate area ticketing. And a Ground
Ambassador in the departure lounge.
In flight, you have a choice of 5 entrees
in First Class, 3 in Coach. Premium brands
of liquor, imported wines and champagnes,
and 8 channels of stereo.
Ambassador Service and the L-1011.
Nobody else gives you anything like it.
THE COACH LOUNGE
Ithas a big, fully equipped
bar. Comfortable seats
and alcoves to stretch out
and relax in. And a most
convivial atmosphere.
COACH
The new Twin Seats in
TWA's L- 1011 are the
finest Coach seats in the
air. You'll never have to
sit more than two across.
In the center section,
seats fold down and the
arm rests fold up. If the
plane's not full, you can
have a private area for
work or conversation or
even an enormous couch.
MORE SPACE
EVERYWHERE
The L-1011 gives you
more individual aisle and
seat space than any other
plane we fly. There are
carry-on luggage com-
partments in First Class
and Coach. Self-locking
overhead compartments.
Coat compartments and
special racks that disap-
pear into the wall at the
touch of a button.
FIRST CLASS
The whole First Class
lounge. in the center, club
around
lounge
tables swivel 270 degrees.
Very convenient for con-
versation or cocktails. At
meal time, we'll soon be
serving rather elegant
dinners for four at these
locations.
STREAMLINED
MEAL SERVICE
For the first ume on dry
plane, you'll enjoy the
dual advantage of a be-
low-deck galley and the
aisles free of serving
carts. Meals are prepared
in the galley's high speed
ovens, brought upstairs
by special elevators 10
satellite centers, and per-
sonally served by your
flight attendant.
